verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in metrics that can be turned on through configuration, and Whisker, a community-described live debugger for viewing pipeline frames. These are telemetry primitives and debugging aids, not documented production call monitoring. Nothing in the pack shows alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
